sqlMap.select: SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, (SELECT MAX(O.ORDER_DATE) FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID) AS lastOrderDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS O2 WHERE O2.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID) AS orderCount FROM CUSTOMER C WHERE C.STATUS = #status#
SELECT T.CUSTOMER_ID, T.TOTAL_PAYMENT FROM ( SELECT PM.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(PM.PAYMENT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_PAYMENT FROM PAYMENT PM GROUP BY PM.CUSTOMER_ID ) T WHERE T.TOTAL_PAYMENT >= #minPayment#

SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, P1.TOTAL_PAYMENT AS totalPayment FROM CUSTOMER C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PM.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(PM.PAYMENT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_PAYMENT FROM PAYMENT PM GROUP BY PM.CUSTOMER_ID ) P1 ON P1.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE C.REGION_CODE = #regionCode#
SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME FROM CUSTOMER C WHERE C.CUSTOMER_ID IN ( SELECT O.CUSTOMER_ID FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.STATUS = #orderStatus# )
SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW R WHERE R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND R.SCORE >= #minScore# )

SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, P1.TOTAL_PAYMENT AS totalPayment FROM CUSTOMER C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PM.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(PM.PAYMENT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_PAYMENT FROM PAYMENT PM WHERE PM.ORDER_ID IN ( SELECT OD.ORDER_ID FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD WHERE OD.QUANTITY > #minQuantity# ) GROUP BY PM.CUSTOMER_ID ) P1 ON P1.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE C.STATUS = #status#

SELECT OUTER_T.CUSTOMER_ID, OUTER_T.PAID FROM ( SELECT INNER_T.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(INNER_T.AMOUNT) AS PAID FROM ( SELECT PM.CUSTOMER_ID, PM.PAYMENT_AMOUNT AS AMOUNT FROM PAYMENT PM WHERE PM.PAYMENT_TYPE = 'CARD' ) INNER_T GROUP BY INNER_T.CUSTOMER_ID ) OUTER_T
